Class UniversityStudent

java.lang.Object
Student
UniversityStudent
public class UniversityStudent extends Student
UniversityStudent represents a concrete student at a university and extends Student.

It stores roommate links, preferences and previous internships and implements a simple connection-strength heuristic used by the graph-building code.

    • calculateConnectionStrength

      public int calculateConnectionStrength(Student other)
      A simple heuristic measuring connection strength between two students.

      Scoring rules used by the algorithm:

      • +4 if students are roommates
      • +3 for each shared previous internship
      • +2 if they share the same major
      • +1 if they have the same age
      Specified by:
      calculateConnectionStrength in class Student
      Parameters:
      other - the other student to compare with
      Returns:
      integer score representing connection strength (>=0)
